narrative.overview: The page is a set of sheets documenting one coordinated machine network. Each section is a sheet with a number (A-01 to A-11), a Geist Mono title block, hairline rules and, in the hero, an A-L column ruler on the 12-column grid. Paper is warm white, ink is charcoal, annotation is cool gray, and a single electric lime appears only as the revision marker. Night sheets invert the same grammar. Imagery is procedural Three.js only, and anything that looks like data is labelled demonstration data on the surface.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, charcoal ink, cool-gray annotation; lime as rare accent.
1px hairlines, registration corners, tick rules, mono labels as furniture.
Radii of 2-4px only; flat, no decorative shadow.
Geist for everything read, Geist Mono for everything annotated.
0.35-0.9s ease-out motion, one curve, no loops except dashed flow lines.

rules.name: The Revision Marker Rule
rules.body: Lime marks action, "now" or live. It is never a background wash, never a heading colour, never decoration.

rules.name: The Two Grays Rule
rules.body: Small text uses mute-aa; mute is for large type, rules and 3D. Never set small text in mute on paper.

rules.name: The Same Grammar Rule
rules.body: Night sheets reuse the same furniture with paper-alpha hairlines; they do not get new devices.

rules.name: The Mono Is Annotation Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for drawing furniture and data captions. Never use it for headings or running copy.

rules.name: The Tracking Scales Rule
rules.body: Tighter tracking as size grows (-0.025em to -0.04em); wordmark alone is spaced out at +0.2em, weight 600.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Panels are paper with a 1px hair-strong border. No offset or hard shadows, no glow on UI chrome.

dos: Do give every new section a sheet number, a mono title block and data-theme so the rail and ink flip correctly.
Do label any figure, map value or log as demonstration, sample, target or illustrative on the surface itself.
Do use mute-aa for small text, and keep body text at or above 4.5:1.
Do make new imagery procedural, lit from the existing material roles, on the paper or night ground.
Do keep radii at 2-4px and borders at 1px hairlines.
donts: Don't use lime as a background wash, heading colour or decoration.
Don't introduce shadows, glow or gradients on UI chrome beyond the existing dropdown.
Don't replace the drawing furniture with a row of equal cards on stock photography.
Don't use Geist Mono for headings or paragraphs.
Don't ship raster photography or unlabelled metrics.
Don't add looping, bouncing or constantly floating motion.
